path_normalization: Command and diagnostic paths are repository-relative; report hashes identify original unnormalized reports.
changes: NativeAnalysis fixed Darwin C calls transport complete SIMD128 values in Q registers, aligned stack slots and Q0 results through one shared packet layout.
Recovered indirect records retain original address operands and x8 output storage, without logical copies or stronger memory, lifetime and aliasing promises.
Native frame and Boolean-result proofs require the complete architecture target width; generic 32-bit call-occurrence identity remains available.
Unmodelled HVA records do not become integer or indirect arguments. Legacy Apple llvm.ptrauth globals refuse before incompatible backend code generation instead of aborting.

working_dependencies.policy: Existing working-tree dependency revisions are recorded, not staged as arm64e changes.
